elements.note: REWRITTEN on high-zoom re-read 2026-07-27 (recording a reversal): the earlier entry gave the main mass a number-direction ridge 0.50 m north of grid C. There is NO such ridge -- the main mass is square (11.40 x 11.40 incl. oversails) and its four hips converge at a SINGLE POINT on that line. The heavy dashed horizontal that crosses the whole sheet at almost exactly that height is the A-A SECTION LINE (to A-12), which is almost certainly what the first pass mistook for a ridge -- the same misreading happened independently on S-06, where the culprit was the central rafter line. The wing's letter-direction ridge at x = 2.00 is real (its two hips and the valley hang off it).
Only three section lines are marked on the roof plan -- A-A, B-B and C-C. D-D, which is marked on both floor plans, is NOT repeated here.

warnings: *** THIS SHEET INDEPENDENTLY CONFIRMS THE ROOF GEOMETRY TRACED FROM LINE WEIGHTS ON S-06 -- REWRITTEN 2026-07-27 to record that the confirmation originally included a SHARED MISREADING. *** Both sheets agree on: main mass grid 1-1.20 to grid 3+1.20, wing grid 1-1.20 to grid 2+1.20 with its letter-direction ridge at about x = 2.00, hips crossing on the line about 0.50-0.60 m north of grid C. But what both files first called 'the main ridge' on that line does not exist: the hips of the square main mass meet at a POINT there. On this sheet the heavy horizontal at that height is the A-A section line; on S-06 it is the central rafter line -- two different innocent look-alikes that produced the same wrong conclusion on two sheets, which is exactly why the earlier 'independent confirmation' held. Corrected on both files 2026-07-27; the S-06 flag roof_topology_traced_from_line_weight can still be regarded as verified for everything except that phantom ridge.
IT ALSO SUPPLIES THE PITCH THE STRUCTURAL SET NEVER GAVE: SLOPE 25°, printed on every plane of both the main mass and the wing.

The 1.20 m eaves oversail is printed on all four sides here, whereas S-06 dimensioned it in seven separate places and left the boundary between the main mass and the wing undimensioned. That boundary is still not dimensioned on this sheet either -- it is read off the ridge position, so the main mass's south edge is still approximate.
ONLY THREE SECTION MARKS APPEAR HERE (A-A, B-B, C-C). D-D is marked on both floor plans but not on the roof plan.

The right-wing roof is a thin dashed reference outline only -- it is drawn properly on A-06, which is where its own SLOPE 25° arrows and the METAL SHEET area live. The metal-sheet roof over the car port does NOT appear on this sheet at all.
Roof structure is deferred throughout: 'โครงสร้างดูแบบวิศวกรรม' -- see S-06 for the main mass and S-05 for the right wing.
